"Sirf chahna nahi—kaam karo."
"Dreams tabhi kaam karti jab tum karte."
Focused raho; distraction mehngi padti hai.
Aage ja rahe ho ya peeche—tum move kar rahe ho.
Shuruaat karne ka tareeqa hai ki baatein band karein aur kaam karna shuru karein.
Main taiyari karunga aur ek din mera avsar zaroor aayega.
Hum wahi bante hain jo din bhar sochte hain.
Apna future banao.
World mein persistence ka replacement nahi.
"Future depend karta hai—today tum kya karte."
